purpose: taxids for 25 clade/species names, by exact ontology label, batch 2
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(?l, "^(Ovalentaria|Atherinomorphae|Beloniformes|Belonoidei|Exocoetidae|Adrianichthyidae|Oryzias|Liparidae|Sarcopterygii|Dipnotetrapodomorpha|Tetrapoda|Amphibia|Anura|Xenopus|Amniota|Lepidosauria|Testudines|Crocodylia|Mammalia|Theria|Eutheria|Glires|Rodentia|Myomorpha|Muridae)( <[^>]*>)?$")) }
